<title>VersaLux Innovations — Redefining the Shower Experience</title>

<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{--navy:#0c1a3a;--navy-mid:#102050;--blue:#1a5bc4;--blue-light:#3b82f6;--off-white:#f4f7ff;--gray:#6b7280;--light-gray:#e8edf8;--gold:#c9a84c}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#111;overflow-x:hidden}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(12,26,58,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);transition:padding .3s}

#hero{min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-mid) 55%,#0e2d6e 100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;padding:120px 80px 80px;gap:60px}

.fm span{color:var(--gray)}
.mvs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}

.tl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:22px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--light-gray)}

.tlc h4{font-size:.98rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:6px}
.tlc p{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--gray)}
#moat{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0a2060 100%)}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:40px}
.mcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:14px;padding:28px 20px;text-align:center}
.mico{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.mcard h4{font-size:.96rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:10px}

.mclos{background:rgba(201,168,76,.09);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.24);border-radius:14px;padding:30px 34px;font-size:.96rem;line-height:1.85;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);font-style:italic}
.mclos strong{color:var(--gold);font-style:normal}
#partners{background:var(--off-white);text-align:center}
.pbody{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--gray);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 36px}
.cblock{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--light-gray);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 26px}
.cblock a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem}
#waitlist{background:var(--navy);text-align:center}
.wform{display:flex;gap:12px;max-width:450px;margin:0 auto;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.wform input{flex:1;min-width:190px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;font-size:.92rem;outline:none;font-family:inherit;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}
.wform input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.wform input:focus{border-color:var(--blue-light)}
.wform button{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:background .2s}
.wform button:hover{background:var(--blue-light)}
#wm{margin-top:14px;font-size:.9rem;color:#60a5fa;display:none}

footer{background:var(--navy);color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);padding:40px 80px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.flogo img{height:32px;width:auto;opacity:.82}
.ftxt{font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.7;text-align:center}
.flinks{display:flex;gap:20px}
.flinks a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.50);text-decoration:none;font-size:.78rem;transition:color .2s}
.flinks a:hover{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:960px){
  #hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:110px 32px 60px;text-align:center}

  section{padding:60px 28px}
  .statbar{padding:20px 28px}
  nav{padding:12px 24px}
  .nav-links{display:none}
  .pgrid,.mgrid,.hgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .sol,.agrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px}

}

</head>
<body>
<nav id="nb">
  <div class="nav-logo"><a href="#hero"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="VersaLux Innovations"></a></div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#problem">The Problem</a></li>
    <li><a href="#surfaces">The Product</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">Our Story</a></li>
    <li><a href="#partners">Partners</a></li>
    <li><a href="#waitlist">Get Updates</a></li>
  </ul>
  <a href="#waitlist" class="nav-cta">Get Updates</a>
</nav>

<section id="hero">
  <div>
    <div class="hero-badge">Patent Pending &nbsp;·&nbsp; Trademark Registered</div>
    <h1>Multiple Layers.<br><em>One Clean.</em></h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">VersaLux brings multiple bathing surfaces and an integrated soap-dispensing system together in one product — designed to make everyday bathing simpler, smarter, and more luxurious.</p>
    <div class="pills">
      <span class="pill">Dual-Layer Reversible</span>
      <span class="pill">Integrated Soap Dispenser</span>
      <span class="pill">Magnetic Closure</span>
      <span class="pill">Ambidextrous Design</span>
      <span class="pill">Family Sizing</span>
    </div>
    <div class="btns">
      <a href="#waitlist" class="btn-p">Get Product Updates</a>
      <a href="#surfaces" class="btn-o">See How It Works</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-img">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="VersaLux — open mitt showing dual-layer construction and integrated soap dispenser">
  </div>
</section>

<div class="statbar">
  <div class="stat"><div class="snum">$18B+</div><div class="slbl">Global Market Size</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="snum">3</div><div class="slbl">USPTO Trademark Classes</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="snum">5</div><div class="slbl">Integrated Materials</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="snum">2016</div><div class="slbl">Founded · Cibolo, TX</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="snum">0</div><div class="slbl">Direct Competitors</div></div>
</div>

<section id="problem">
  <p class="ey">The Problem</p>
  <h2 class="st lt">A $18B+ Market. No Real Innovation.</h2>
  <p class="ss lt">Despite the personal care accessories market exceeding $18 billion globally, the fundamental design of bathing tools has seen virtually no meaningful innovation in decades. Loofahs, washcloths, bath sponges, and exfoliating gloves all suffer from the same core structural limitations.</p>
  <div class="mcall">
    <strong>$18B+</strong>
    <span>The global personal care accessories market is enormous, growing, and <strong style="color:#fff">profoundly underserved</strong> by meaningful product innovation. The last category-defining bathing product was the loofah — unchanged for over a century.</span>
  </div>
  <div class="pgrid">
    <div class="pcard"><div class="pnum">01</div><div class="ptit">Interruption of Routine</div><p class="pdesc">Users must stop bathing to reach for and apply soap, disrupting the experience and creating inconvenience — particularly for individuals with limited mobility.</p></div>
    <div class="pcard"><div class="pnum">02</div><div class="ptit">Single-Surface Limitation</div><p class="pdesc">Loofahs, washcloths, and sponges offer only one texture. Consumers must own multiple tools to exfoliate, cleanse, and perform sensitive skin care.</p></div>
    <div class="pcard"><div class="pnum">03</div><div class="ptit">Hygiene Degradation</div><p class="pdesc">Traditional tools accumulate bacteria rapidly due to moisture retention and improper storage — creating a genuine hygiene risk consumers are increasingly aware of.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="surfaces">
  <p class="ey">What VersaLux Brings Together</p>
  <h2 class="st">Different Materials. One Bathing Solution.</h2>
  <p class="ss">Different materials are integrated into the VersaLux concept, so more than one bathing surface is available on the same product — one thing to reach for, one thing to rinse, one thing to hang.</p>
  <div class="sgrid">
    <div class="scard"><div class="snum2">01</div><div class="sname">Terry</div><p class="sdesc">A traditional bathing textile built into the VersaLux surface layers for gentle everyday cleansing.</p></div>
    <div class="scard"><div class="snum2">02</div><div class="sname">Microfiber</div><p class="sdesc">A second fabric surface alongside the terry — ideal for sensitive and facial skin.</p></div>
    <div class="scard"><div class="snum2">03</div><div class="sname">Silicone</div><p class="sdesc">Included as a distinct textured surface and structural inner lining.</p></div>
    <div class="scard"><div class="snum2">04</div><div class="sname">Nylon Exfoliating</div><p class="sdesc">The exfoliating surface integrated into the outer layer — no separate accessory needed.</p></div>
    <div class="scard"><div class="snum2">05</div><div class="sname">Integrated Components</div><p class="sdesc">Neodymium magnets, internal soap bladder, hanging loop — all built into one product.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="howit" style="background:var(--navy)">
  <p class="ey" style="color:#93c5fd">How the Soap System Works</p>
  <h2 class="st lt">A Lux Clean in Every Squeeze.</h2>
  <p class="ss lt" style="margin-bottom:44px">Soap is already where you're washing. No reaching, no interruptions — just squeeze and continue.</p>
  <div class="hgrid">
    <div class="hcard"><div class="hstep">Step 01</div><h4>Fill the Internal Bladder</h4><p>Fill the internal squeeze-bulb dispenser with your liquid soap. The check valve keeps soap contained and ready until you need it.</p></div>
    <div class="hcard"><div class="hstep">Step 02</div><h4>Squeeze to Dispense</h4><p>A gentle squeeze delivers soap directly through the palm pouch to the cleaning surface — exactly where you're already washing.</p></div>
    <div class="hcard"><div class="hstep">Step 03</div><h4>Lather and Continue</h4><p>Lather on the surface you're washing with. No reaching. No interruption. One product — start to finish.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="solution">
  <p class="ey">Key Innovations</p>
  <h2 class="st">One Mitt. Three Surfaces. Zero Interruptions.</h2>
  <div class="sol">
    <div class="sol-img">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="VersaLux mitt open position showing inner washing layer">
      <div class="pbadge"><strong>Patent Pending</strong>Design &amp; Utility</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p style="font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:24px">No existing product — from any brand — offers all of these features in combination. VersaLux is not competing in a category. It is creating one.</p>
      <div class="ilist">
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#128260;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Three Usable Surfaces</h4><p>Exfoliating outer (closed), terry cloth front (reversed), terry cloth back (face-safe) — one mitt, three complete functions.</p></div></div>
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#128167;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Integrated Soap Delivery</h4><p>Squeeze-bulb dispenser with check valve in a Velcro-sealed palm pouch — soap delivered with no reaching.</p></div></div>
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#129352;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Dual-Mode Magnetic Closure</h4><p>Neodymium magnets — secure seal in both closed and reversed positions. Single-handed operation.</p></div></div>
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#128218;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Book-Spine Assembly</h4><p>Permanently sewn left seam; magnetic right seam enables smooth single-handed reversal between modes.</p></div></div>
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#129309;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Ambidextrous Design</h4><p>Fitted wrist cuff, hanging loop, and dual thumb holes — comfortable for left- and right-handed users.</p></div></div>
        <div class="inno"><div class="iico">&#128106;</div><div class="itxt"><h4>Multiple Sizing</h4><p>Adult Large, Medium, Small, and Junior — one premium experience for the whole family.</p></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="prototype" style="background:var(--off-white)">
  <p class="ey">Development</p>
  <h2 class="st">From Idea to Working Prototype.</h2>
  <p class="ss">VersaLux has moved beyond concept development to a physical working prototype. The company is continuing product development as it prepares for the next stages of the business.</p>
  <div class="tl">
    <div class="tli"><div class="tldot">&#128161;</div><div class="tlc"><h4>Concept — 2016</h4><p>The original idea for a single, multi-function bathing product — born from one simple question: why does a shower require so many separate products?</p></div></div>
    <div class="tli"><div class="tldot">&#9881;&#65039;</div><div class="tlc"><h4>Working Prototype</h4><p>A physical prototype incorporating terry, microfiber, silicone, nylon exfoliating material, neodymium magnets, an internal soap bladder, and a hanging loop.</p></div></div>
    <div class="tli"><div class="tldot">&#128737;&#65039;</div><div class="tlc"><h4>IP Protection</h4><p>VersaLux trademarked across USPTO Classes 021, 024, and 035. Design and utility patent applications filed and patent pending.</p></div></div>
    <div class="tli" style="padding-bottom:0"><div class="tldot">&#128640;</div><div class="tlc"><h4>Continued Development</h4><p>Ongoing refinement and preparation for commercial launch. No pricing, launch date, or availability has been established.</p></div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="about">
  <div class="agrid">
    <div>
      <p class="ey">Our Story</p>
      <div class="fi">Built from a <span>decade of conviction</span> and one relentless founder.</div>
      <div class="fb">
        <p>Robert Herron Jr. founded VersaLux Innovations LLC in 2016 in Cibolo, Texas, with one goal: to eliminate the unnecessary complexity of the everyday shower routine.</p>
        <p>What started as a simple question — <em>"Why does a simple shower require so many separate products?"</em> — became a design challenge, then a working prototype, and now a patent-pending product category of its own.</p>
        <p>A decade of founder commitment has produced a trademarked brand, a patent-pending product, and a clear path to commercial launch.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="fmeta">
        <div class="fm"><strong>2016</strong><span>Founded</span></div>
        <div class="fm"><strong>Cibolo, TX</strong><span>Headquarters</span></div>
        <div class="fm"><strong>3 Classes</strong><span>USPTO Trademark</span></div>
        <div class="fm"><strong>Pending</strong><span>Design &amp; Utility</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div>

        <div class="mvc"><div class="mvl">Vision Statement</div><p>"To become the leading brand in premium personal care accessories, recognized globally for transforming the shower from a routine task into a truly luxurious experience."</p></div>
        <div class="tmb"><div class="mvl" style="margin-bottom:8px">USPTO Trademark Protection</div><p>The VersaLux brand is trademarked across <strong>Class 021</strong> (household utensils), <strong>Class 024</strong> (textiles and fabrics), and <strong>Class 035</strong> (advertising and business services).</p></div>

  <h2 class="st lt">No Direct Competitor Offers This Combination.</h2>
  <p class="ss lt" style="margin-bottom:44px">The integrated dispenser + reversible construction + magnetic closure system represents an entirely new product category. Upon patent grant, this combination will be legally protected.</p>

    <div class="mcard"><div class="mico">&#8482;&#65039;</div><h4>Trademark Portfolio</h4><p>Trademarked across three USPTO classifications — broad brand protection across the personal care accessories market.</p></div>
    <div class="mcard"><div class="mico">&#127942;</div><h4>Category Creation</h4><p>VersaLux is not competing in an existing category — it is creating one. First-mover advantage in a self-defined category is the most durable position in consumer goods.</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="mclos">We believe VersaLux represents a genuine <strong>category innovation</strong> in personal care accessories — a market that is large, growing, and profoundly underserved. A decade of founder commitment has produced a trademarked brand, a patent-pending product, and a clear path to commercial launch. <strong>We invite you to be part of what comes next.</strong></div>
